description: Source code for a custom test reporter class 'ListReporter' used in Playwright testing framework, responsible for displaying test progress and results in terminal environments.

classes.name: ListReporter
classes.description: A terminal-based test reporter class that displays test progress, steps, and results with color coding and dynamic line updates.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of an individual test, assigns index, and displays test title.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Outputs standard output chunks during test execution.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Outputs standard error chunks during test execution.

methods.name: getStepIndex
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a unique index for a test step.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test step, displays step info if configured.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, updates display with step result.

methods.name: _maybeWriteNewLine
methods.description: Writes a new line if needed for display updates.

methods.name: _updateLineCountAndNewLineFlagForOutput
methods.description: Updates internal counters based on output text length.

methods.name: _dumpToStdio
methods.description: Outputs chunks to the given stream, respecting quiet mode.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles test completion, updates display with test result.

methods.name: _updateOrAppendLine
methods.description: Updates existing line or appends a new line in terminal display.

methods.name: _appendLine
methods.description: Appends a line of text to terminal output.

methods.name: _updateLine
methods.description: Updates a specific line in terminal output.

methods.name: _updateLineForTTY
methods.description: Handles line update in TTY environments using escape sequences.

methods.name: _testPrefix
methods.description: Generates prefix string for test lines based on index and status.

methods.name: _retrySuffix
methods.description: Returns suffix string if test is a retry.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during test execution, outputs error message.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of test suite, outputs final results.
